params.label: Seed
params.help: Seeds the graph, sensors and agents; same seed and settings = same run.

params.label: Hosts
params.help: null = seeded 12-16. More hosts give red more paths and blue more to watch.

params.label: Round limit
params.help: Rounds before blue wins by holding out. Raising it gives red more time to reach the crown jewel.

params.label: Sensor pool size
params.help: Pre-scored classifier rows per sensor and class (fixed detectors; adaptive runs use the Adaptation pool size). Raising it gives more varied readings, slower start.

params.label: Phish success
params.help: Chance a phishing email lands a foothold. Raising it makes initial access and re-entry easier.

params.label: Exploit success
params.help: Chance an exploit on an unpatched host succeeds. Raising it speeds red's spread.

params.label: Exploit success (patched)
params.help: Chance an exploit still works on a patched host. Raising it weakens blue's patching.

params.label: Recon bonus
params.help: Extra exploit chance on a host red has scanned. Raising it rewards careful reconnaissance.

params.label: Escalation success
params.help: Chance of gaining admin on a foothold. Raising it lets red reach exfiltration sooner.

params.label: Escalation success (patched)
params.help: Chance escalation works on a patched host. Raising it weakens blue's patching.

params.label: Lateral move success
params.help: Chance an admin foothold pivots to a neighbour. Raising it speeds red through the network.

params.label: Exfiltration success
params.help: Chance stealing from the crown jewel works once red holds it. Raising it shortens red's endgame.

params.label: Phish while footholds <=
params.help: Phishing is offered only while red holds at most this many hosts. Raising it makes phishing an expansion tool, not just re-entry.

params.label: Detection threshold
params.help: Classifier score needed for monitoring to flag a host. Raising it means fewer false alarms but more missed intrusions.

params.label: Malware implant leak
params.help: Chance a compromised host shows a malicious malware reading when monitored. Raising it makes footholds easier to spot.

params.label: Phishing implant leak
params.help: Chance a compromised host shows a malicious phishing reading when monitored. Raising it makes footholds easier to spot.

params.label: Network implant leak
params.help: Chance a compromised host shows a malicious network reading when monitored. Raising it makes footholds easier to spot.

params.label: Credential reset evicts
params.help: Chance resetting credentials kicks a non-admin foothold out. Raising it makes resets a stronger response.

params.label: Recon noise
params.help: Chance a recon attempt makes its host emit a malicious sensor reading. Raising it makes that red action louder and easier for blue to detect.

params.label: Phishing noise
params.help: Chance a phishing attempt makes its host emit a malicious sensor reading. Raising it makes that red action louder and easier for blue to detect.

params.label: Exploit noise
params.help: Chance an exploit attempt makes its host emit a malicious sensor reading. Raising it makes that red action louder and easier for blue to detect.

params.label: Escalation noise
params.help: Chance an escalation attempt makes its host emit a malicious sensor reading. Raising it makes that red action louder and easier for blue to detect.

params.label: Lateral move noise
params.help: Chance a lateral move attempt makes its host emit a malicious sensor reading. Raising it makes that red action louder and easier for blue to detect.

params.label: Exfiltration noise
params.help: Chance an exfiltration attempt makes its host emit a malicious sensor reading. Raising it makes that red action louder and easier for blue to detect.

params.label: Win reward
params.help: Reward for winning. Raising it makes the final outcome dominate shaping.

params.label: New foothold
params.help: Red's reward for each new host. Raising it pushes red to spread wide.

params.label: Server foothold
params.help: Extra red reward for owning a server. Raising it draws red toward servers.

params.label: Crown-jewel foothold
params.help: Extra red reward for owning the crown jewel. Raising it makes red beeline for it.

params.label: Privilege gain
params.help: Red's reward for each escalation. Raising it encourages escalating before moving.

params.label: Foothold lost
params.help: Red's penalty (blue's gain) when a foothold is removed. Raising it makes evictions matter more.

params.label: Time pressure
params.help: Red pays this per turn and blue earns it. Raising it hurries red.

params.label: Rule set
params.help: default: isolating a clean host costs blue 0.3 at once plus 0.03 per turn it stays cut off, so blue has to be fairly sure before it isolates. cheap-isolation: the previous rules where isolating a clean host was nearly free (0.1 / 0.01), so blue could win by cutting off hosts on a hunch. Individual reward settings below still override the rule set.

params.label: Correct isolation
params.help: Blue's reward for isolating a truly compromised host. Raising it makes blue quicker to isolate.

params.label: Wrong isolation
params.help: Blue's penalty for isolating a clean host (default 0.3; 0.1 under the cheap-isolation rules). Raising it makes blue more cautious.

params.label: True detection
params.help: Blue's reward when monitoring flags a compromised host. Raising it encourages monitoring.

params.label: False positive
params.help: Blue's penalty when monitoring flags a clean host. Raising it discourages noisy monitoring.

params.label: Isolation upkeep
params.help: Blue's cost per isolated host per turn (business disruption; default 0.03, 0.01 under the cheap-isolation rules). Raising it makes blue restore sooner.

params.label: Episodes
params.help: Training games. Raising it gives the learners more practice (slower).

params.label: Eval every
params.help: Episodes between win-rate checkpoints. Lowering it gives a finer chart but slower runs.

params.label: Eval games
params.help: Games per matchup at each checkpoint. Raising it gives a less noisy win-rate chart (slower).

params.label: Logged eval games
params.help: Eval games per matchup per checkpoint saved for replay. Raising it gives more to replay, bigger logs.

params.label: Learner type
params.help: How the two learning sides think. Neural network (dqn): a small TensorFlow network scores every possible move, including which host to hit. Lookup table (tabular): the older learner that only picks the kind of move and lets a fixed rule pick the host.

params.label: Network learning rate
params.help: Step size of the neural network's training (dqn only). Raising it learns faster but less stably.

params.label: Network size
params.help: Hidden layer sizes of the neural network (dqn only), e.g. 64,64 = two layers of 64. Bigger networks can learn subtler play but need more games.

params.label: Network discount
params.help: How much future reward counts for the neural network learner (dqn only; the lookup table uses Discount). Raising it makes it plan further ahead.

params.label: Look-ahead steps
params.help: Moves of real reward the network sums before trusting its own estimate (dqn only). Raising it spreads the win/loss signal back faster but noisier.

params.label: Memory size
params.help: Past moves the network remembers and re-learns from (dqn only). Larger remembers older play; smaller adapts faster to the current opponent.

params.label: Batch size
params.help: Remembered moves per training step (dqn only). Raising it gives smoother but slower learning.

params.label: Target refresh
params.help: Training steps between refreshes of the network's frozen copy that sets its learning targets (dqn only). Raising it is more stable but slower to improve.

params.label: Train every
params.help: Own moves between training steps (dqn only). Lowering it trains more often (slower runs).

params.label: Learning rate
params.help: Lookup-table learner only: how far each update moves a Q-value at the start. Raising it learns faster but less stably.

params.label: Final learning rate
params.help: Lookup-table learner only: learning rate at the end of training (linear decay). Raising it keeps learning plastic late on.

params.label: Discount
params.help: Lookup-table learner only: how much future reward counts. Raising it makes agents plan further ahead.

params.label: Exploration start
params.help: Chance of a random move at the start. Use about 0.3 when continuing from a saved run.

params.label: Exploration end
params.help: Chance of a random move after decay. Raising it keeps agents experimenting.

params.label: Exploration decay
params.help: Fraction of training over which exploration decays. Raising it explores for longer.

params.label: Disguised-attacker tests
params.help: At every checkpoint, learned blue also plays the scripted attacker disguising all its activity at these fixed levels (comma-separated, 0.1-0.7; empty = off). This is the test of whether blue's detectors keep up with disguise; with adaptive detectors off they stay the original models.

params.label: Disguised-attacker test games
params.help: Games per disguise level at each checkpoint (they count toward that level's win rate only). Raising it gives a less noisy disguised-attacker chart (slower).

params.label: Baseline type
params.help: Fixed opponent the learners train against and are scored against. Random is much weaker.

params.label: Baseline red noise
params.help: Chance the baseline attacker plays a random move. Raising it makes it weaker and less predictable.

params.label: Baseline blue noise
params.help: Chance the baseline defender plays a random move. Raising it makes it weaker and less predictable.

params.label: Warm-start side
params.help: With --init-from, which learners start from the saved run's networks or Q-tables (same learner type only); the other starts fresh. Blue also brings the saved detector versions, red its evasion levels.

params.label: Adaptive detectors
params.help: On: blue's three detectors keep learning from hosts blue investigates, and red learns how much to disguise its activity. Off: the original fixed detectors and a red that never disguises anything.

params.label: Detector learning rate
params.help: How big each detector fine-tuning step is. Raising it adapts faster but forgets old traffic sooner; 1e-4 barely moves the models.

params.label: Retrain detectors every
params.help: Games between detector updates. Lowering it makes blue's detectors react faster to red's new disguises (slightly slower runs).

params.label: Minimum new examples
params.help: Labelled readings a detector needs (with some of each kind) before it retrains. Raising it means fewer, better-informed updates.

params.label: Cost of disguise
params.help: How much disguising activity slows red down: success chance x (1 - cost x disguise level). Raising it makes heavy disguise expensive, so red settles on lighter disguise.

params.label: Red adaptation rate
params.help: How quickly red's disguise choices react to recent games. Raising it makes red switch disguise level sooner after being caught (and noisier).

params.label: Red disguise experiments
params.help: Chance red tries a random disguise level in a game instead of its current best. Raising it lets red notice sooner when an old level works again.

params.label: Red's fear of being seen
params.help: How much red counts each of its readings that a detector flags, against the progress it made. Raising it makes red disguise more heavily.

params.label: Phishing forensics
params.help: On: when blue investigates a host it also reviews that host's mailbox, including the email behind red's first foothold, and proving a phished foothold makes blue search every mailbox for red's other phishing emails. This gives the phishing detector enough labelled examples to keep up with disguise. Changes only what the detectors learn from, not the game itself. Off = the v3 behaviour.

params.label: Phishing campaign size
params.help: With phishing forensics on: how many workstations received the phishing email that gave red its first foothold (only one clicked). Raising it gives blue more phishing examples once it uncovers the campaign.

params.label: Readings per disguise level
params.help: Pre-scored readings per sensor and disguise level when detectors adapt. Larger pools make detectors generalise instead of memorising the exact readings they were retrained on.

params.label: Detector updates (diagnostic)
params.help: Separates the two halves of adaptation for experiments. auto: follow Adaptive detectors. adaptive: detectors keep retraining. frozen: blue keeps the original detectors for the whole run, but readings still come from the adaptive sensor pools (so only the retraining is switched off). Needs Adaptive detectors on.

params.label: Red disguise (diagnostic)
params.help: Separates the two halves of adaptation for experiments. auto: follow Adaptive detectors. bandit: the learned red picks how much to disguise its activity. off: red never disguises (level 0 on every sensor), even while blue's detectors retrain. Needs Adaptive detectors on.

params.label: Blue's view of scores (diagnostic)
params.help: How blue's neural network sees detector scores. raw: the score itself. clean_quantile: where the score sits among the current detector's scores on clean traffic (0.99 = higher than 99% of clean readings), so retraining a detector does not change what a normal reading looks like to blue. Monitoring still flags on the raw score.

params.label: Learning stats every
params.help: Games per row of learning statistics (Q-table size, TD error, action mix, red's disguise levels).
